title: Chapter 283
text:
One.

The next day, Han Xiao officially released the dungeon missions on a large scale. The players in the sanctuary were pleasantly surprised.

"I didn't expect Black Phantom to have a dungeon mission. Why didn't it appear before?"

"Oh right, the Germinal Organization's main storyline has just ended. Maybe it's to let us experience it again through the dungeon, and Han Xiao is the one who releases the fixed dungeon."

"If that's the case, it's not bad."

The players in the sanctuary did not participate in the war main storyline, so it was a pity. Now that Han Xiao released a dungeon related to the completed main storyline, it was undoubtedly a chance to make up for it.

The players swarmed in, but Han Xiao did not give them away for free this time.

He had set up such a quest. The reward was a Dungeon Crystal, and the requirement was something called 'Contribution Points'. As long as one accepted the quest and bought items, learned skills, and bought chests from him, their purchases would increase their Contribution Points and they would be able to complete the quest.

Since he couldn't sell Dungeon Crystals and couldn't generate any direct profits, he could use a more flexible method. After all, he could set the quest requirements at will and treat the Dungeon Crystals as additional rewards. This would stimulate more players to spend money here and increase his sales.

Players who originally wanted to spend money were even more willing to spend when they saw that they could complete the Instance Dungeon Quests. Players who wanted to complete the Instance Dungeon Quests came to spend money and found that the items he sold were both good and cheap. Then, they fell into the trap, forming a cycle.

This was a promotional method!

The effect was obvious. Han Xiao's first attempt increased his sales by 30%! The results were gratifying.

The most direct effect was that the area around Han Xiao became even more crowded than the subway. There were so many people around him that not even a drop of water could trickle through.

After getting the dungeon crystal, the players called their friends and formed teams to clear the dungeon. The basic process was to enter the dungeon happily and come out with a dumbfounded expression.

The goal of clearing the dungeon was to live to the end. When the dungeon first started, everyone died on the path of revolution. Two days later, someone finally cleared the dungeon, but the completion rate was terrible. They did not complete a single optional mission and only had the lowest basic completion rate.

The four optional missions were the biggest rewards. They spent money on Han Xiao to get the dungeon crystal, but they only got the lowest dungeon reward. Was this not a loss?

The players were not satisfied and suffered like crazy. They were tortured until their mentality collapsed.

The difficulty of the optional missions was completely different from the goal of clearing the dungeon.

"Wow, this dungeon is playable?"

"Black Phantom took eight of my HP. I'm tired …"

Players couldn't help but post on the forum, sharing information and videos of dungeons, and brainstorming.

"After dying so many times, I've come to a conclusion. If I don't die under the orders of the base, it's my loss."

"How do I complete the optional quest? Is this really a level 30 dungeon …?"

An expert player integrated the information and analyzed the storyline of the dungeon based on the five missions.

"This is the general direction of the dungeon. On the first night of entering the dungeon, Hesla's agents took action, and false information was leaked from the base. On the second night, Black Phantom started to act. He killed the patrolling soldiers and infiltrated the base through some unknown means. That night was the key to completing the second mission. Then, the base was on alert, and traces of Black Phantom were discovered. There was a chase, which ended in failure. Following that, Hesla's troops will arrive, and the battle will begin. There is a chance to complete Mission 1 here. Everyone will be trapped in the base, and in the end, the base will explode and you will die. If you survive until this point, you will be considered to have completed the mission. "

A table and video were listed here, showing the things to pay attention to at every step of the dungeon's storyline. Then, the topic changed.

"… Obviously, in this path, there is no chance to complete the last two optional quests. I dare to guess that there are actually two paths in this dungeon. One is the open path, which is the storyline that we have experienced, and the other is the hidden path, which is related to the last two optional quests. So far, no one has triggered them.

In order to defeat the enemy's troops, I think we have to start with intelligence. After some investigation, I found a new opportunity. There is a ten-minute preparation time at the start of the dungeon, which is actually the time before Hesla's agents take action. If we stop them from obtaining intelligence, we may be able to change the direction of the dungeon's storyline. However, this is a fierce battle, and no one has succeeded …

"Finally, a reminder to all players, do not have any contact with Black Phantom! Once you encounter him, you will die. "

Players were very passionate about the dungeon, and there were all kinds of analysis posts on the forum. Han Xiao didn't know the exact situation of the dungeon because although he had selected the clip, the mission was automatically generated. However, he saw the videos shared by players on the forum and knew what the players had experienced.

"The players are actually from the Dark Crow Valley Base camp. Is it because they are in the same camp as me, so this dungeon is not difficult at all?"

Han Xiao was helpless. Suddenly, he had a flash of inspiration. "But this is also good. The higher the difficulty of the dungeon, the higher the reward, the longer the players' passion. I am the person involved, and no one knows the key points of this storyline better than I do. I can make some targeted machines and sell them to the players to help them complete the mission. "

The more benefits the players received from the dungeon, the more help it would be to him. His original intention was not to let the dungeon be difficult for all the players, and he could make a lot of money by selling targeted machines to help the players.

This was a business opportunity!

Han Xiao was a man of action. The next day, he mass-produced targeted machines, special helmets that could protect against long-range sniping, and special auxiliary devices that could help the players move quickly in the jungle. Once they were launched, the players who had been tortured by the dungeon immediately took a fancy to them, and they were sold out immediately.

Where there was demand, there would be a market. This was the market economy, and Han Xiao was very familiar with this. He seized all the opportunities and formed a new business chain. Han Xiao was too lazy to count how many segments he had benefited from. He only knew that a lot of money flew into his wallet.

As the Aquamarine Dollar was not a currency circulating in the universe, he had been spending lavishly on machines, materials, and rare resources. However, not only did the money in his hands not decrease, but it was also increasing at a steady rate.

When Han Technician was still a player, he could not wait to split his money in half. Now, he had so much money that he could not spend it all. Even the Fabian Company's warehouse had been emptied by him, and he needed to restock.

"It's so troublesome to have money …" Han Xiao was really worried. He did not want to bring a pile of Aquamarine Dollars into the galaxy as toilet paper …

…

With the new machines, it was much easier for the players to clear the dungeon. The new machines that he had made became the standard equipment in the eyes of the players. Compared to the generous rewards of the dungeon, the cost was acceptable, and the players felt that it was worth it.

At least one person in a five-person team would have the equipment, and it was basically a necessity.

As the money accumulated, Han Xiao earned an additional bucket of gold. The difficulty level of the dungeon had evolved from NetEase to Tencent. Although Tencent was often criticized, it was still very conscientious compared to NetEase.

Tencent: Play your d * mn * d if you don't have money.

NetEase: Play your d * mn * d.

That was the difference between the two.

"The long-term benefits of being the publisher of the dungeon are very significant. As long as I am in a place, there is no need to worry about attracting players. This is the main storyline of Version 1.0. I can create dungeons that are below level 60 for a long time. I will only create dungeons in the Dark Crow Valley for the time being. When the players slowly level up, I will release new dungeons. This way, I can always satisfy the needs of the players and carry out sustainable development, "Han Xiao calculated.

"Moreover, as more dungeons are released, the players will personally experience my experience. It will be very helpful for me to consolidate and deepen my impression of myself. I have to let the players know that other than being handsome, I have countless good points …"

Han Xiao valued the players. After all, if he wanted to grow quickly, he could not avoid interacting with the players. Furthermore, the players were a group of lawless people, so he did not want to stand on the opposite side of the players. Although he was ahead of the players by a lot, once the players grew up, they could still cause some trouble. This was something that he had to admit. Han Technician was not arrogant.
